candidate_pool: Unchanged native NoDepth requested200 + original target range/covariance/finite-positive mean/SPD checks; canonical row order source(v,u). No reference mask filters pool. k=min(32,N), unavailable if original whole packet unavailable. Native full-pool context retains variable count. This is selection inside the native accepted/capped pool, not recovering NMS-rejected pixels.

adapter.normalization: Mean/population std from training-fold eligible candidate features only; exactly constant std->1; no label/evaluation input.
adapter.policy: Ordered Plackett-Luce without replacement. Score-function expectation, four samples, leave-one-out other-sample loss baseline.
adapter.weight_control: Same8features/parameters, fixed first uniform-seed subset; positive normalized exp(logit) utility weights mean1, applied by dividing both endpoint covariance arrays for the objective only. Not statistical covariance reestimation.

training.model_selection: Final update only; no evaluation-guided checkpoint/feature/epoch selection. Same minibatch scene order across matched learned controls.
training.pose_loss: Successful:1-exp(-[norm(Log(T_est*Ttrue^-1)translation/.01m)^2+norm(Log rotation/rad(.1deg))^2]); failed:1. Failure is never rewarded below a successful bounded task loss.
training.match_loss: 1-mean(exp(-squared forward true pixel reprojection error/(2*1px²))) across selected queries, reward0 for analytically known occluded/outside-FOV/atlas points. Unknown reference support is distinct, never labeled correct by model consistency. Qualify support masks before use.
training.weight_gradient: Central finite differences theta step1e-3, same input subset/order and original solver; base and16perturbation losses retained. Weight-only derivative qualification on real native caches required before training.
training.failure_handling: Every attempted subset/fit retained; no replacement samples or reference-based pruning. Empty/invalid packet or failed fit maps to bounded loss1; evaluation includes availability and matched populations.
training.field_caching: Native model unchanged/eval, one3pair batch per planned scene, no image-noise ensemble; no query/covariance/solver training. Actual fit/inference costs reported per arm.

information_control: Existing greedy Max-logDet with selector-only ridge1e-6*trace(full H)/6 and full-pool depth-length scale; ridge never added to pose solver. Baseline does not become a new method.
evaluation: All80evaluation scenes/fold, deterministic policy topk primary and4seed stochastic context; per group/geometry/motion translation+rotation mean/RMSE, every attempted availability/status, full and common populations. Utility weights not certified measurement variances. No pooled-only/variance-only win.
advancement: On each excluded recording, deterministic pose-reward must reduce translation mean and RMSE at least5% relative to BOTH trained match-reward and weight-only, with no rotation mean/RMSE or availability regression; retain uniform/information/native context. Otherwise close exact recipe without tuning. Development gate, not significance/publication proof.
scope: 600planned artificial scenes, not yet materialized. 360train-profile/240evaluation-profile; three folds each240train/80eval. All existing textures development-exposed; grouping/motion/geometry exclusion does not make a fresh real-world test. Old six fixed-motion diagnostic scenes not used as independent validation.
remaining_before_training: Materialize/audit generalized renderer, reference/visibility and exact planned scene/split IDs
Native scene inference/candidate packets and training-only feature normalization cache lock
Weight-only derivative/interface qualification with original solve failures retained
Bind separate training/numeric source/input/runtime freeze; no geometry/feature/loss/budget tuning from new scores
